source.title: Leopard and spotted hyena camera trap dataset

gates.reason: independent Udzungwa 2013-2014 response dataset; not MICA, Snapshot Japan, or an E2-E4 derivative
formal header retains station, deployment start/end and event timestamp fields, but these coexist in the response-bearing flat file rather than a separate deployment table

public methods report two camera technologies, but the formal public response schema retains neither individual-camera identity nor camera-source identity, so source/protocol cannot be crossed with geography from the released data

paired cameras existed at every field station, but the formal header has no individual camera ID and no camera-side/pair-member field; paired detections therefore cannot be reconstructed as double-observer histories from the released data
164 public field stations exceed count capacity, but no E5 split is frozen after the G4 hard stop
overall survey windows span multiple months but each array ran 12-49 days; split-specific six-month support is not opened or optimized after G4 failure
candidate fails G4 before selected-candidate model freeze

interpretation.supported: field pairing alone is insufficient when public data collapse camera-member identity
not_supported: claim that paired cameras have no detection-calibration value in general
claim about leopard or hyena behavior
any E5 outcome or model result
